name: 76508 · Temple, TX
findings: ZIP 76508 (Temple) has 25 nonprofit organizations. 24 of them (96%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 18 organizations.
Health care organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (79% of those with an identified type).

observations.text: ZIP 76508 (Temple) has 24 organizations listing opportunities online, too few to compare reliably with similar places. Civic life here may run through churches, schools, local government, or informal groups that these records don't capture.
